name: Vertex Search
instructions:
### Schema notes

- A `lesson` does not store its parent course. Derive it with `*[_type == "course" && references(^._id)][0]`.
- Module and lesson numbers (e.g. `5.1`) are positional, derived from `modules[]` and `modules[].lessons[]` order. They are never stored — do not look for a number field.
- `notes` is Portable Text. Match it with `pt::text(notes)` — never match the `notes` field directly.
- `duration` is in seconds.

### Query patterns

- Do NOT use `match` with an array of patterns — that requires ALL patterns to match (AND, not OR). To OR keywords, count how many match: `count($terms[^.title match @ || pt::text(^.notes) match @ || ^.keyPoints[] match @]) > 0` where `$terms` is e.g. `["react*", "hook*"]`.
- Wildcard every keyword (e.g. `"react*"` not `"react"`).

### Video documents

- `video` documents are an internal lookup, never a result on their own. Always tie a matched moment back to the lesson whose `videoUrl` equals the video `url`.
- Resolve a timestamp in two stages: match `chapters[].label` first, fall back to `chunks[].text` only when no chapter matches.
- Never project a whole `chunks` or `chapters` array. Filter inside the projection and take at most 3 matches per video.
- The `video` type may hold zero documents right now. If so, return lesson matches only — never invent a timestamp.

### Fallback

- If `text::semanticSimilarity()` errors with embeddings not enabled, fall back to wildcard keyword matching.
